caption:
Figure 2. Overall architecture of the rubric-guided agentic search framework. Offline (top) involves coarse-to-fine rubric generation with
weighted positive and negative criteria, utility-labeler training by
teacher distillation, rubric-aligned retrieval and multi-task ranking,
and dual-branch selection with GRPO and best-rollout distillation (OPD). Online (bottom) involves dense retrieval of candidate documents
with the trained models, rubric-aligned re-ranking, set selection, and
agent answer synthesis.
